description: LLM chat completion, flat $0.003 a call: send a prompt (plus optional system) or an OpenAI-style messages array and get the reply text with token usage. Models: gpt-oss-20b (default), qwen3-30b, glm-4.7-flash, llama-4-scout. Up to 16,000 characters in and 1,024 tokens out; json=true for JSON output. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

json.description: true asks for a single JSON object

max_tokens.description: Most tokens to generate, up to 1024

prompt.description: The user message (or send an OpenAI-style messages array instead)

name: ai_chat
